name: Valentine
overview: Scripture reveals that love is a powerful and enduring force, exemplified by Jacob's devoted service for Rachel and Ruth's steadfast commitment to Naomi, reflecting personal sacrifice and loyalty. Proverbs teaches that love covers sins and sustains friendships through all circumstances, highlighting its protective and faithful nature. Ultimately, the greatest demonstration of love is God's gift of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe, underscoring the divine foundation of true love beyond human experience.
